title: linus-torvalds-skill
brief: Distills Linus Torvalds' code-review methodology from ~38k review moves extracted from 31k of his LKML emails (2002–2026) plus 67 interview transcripts into a reusable, language-agnostic agent skill. Ships four variants distilled by different LLMs (gpt-oss, GLM, Mistral, Qwen) with validation reports comparing skilled vs. baseline reviews; the gpt-oss variant is the recommended default.
details: This repo distills Linus Torvalds' code-review methodology from roughly 31,000 Linux kernel mailing list emails (38,293 extracted review moves, 2002–2026) into reusable AI agent skills and a "soul" persona. Four skill variants were distilled by different LLMs (gpt-oss-120b, GLM, Mistral, Qwen3.8-27b) so you can pick balanced, detailed, concise, or practical flavors; all share the core precedence of Correctness over Performance over Complexity over Style. Drop a SKILL.md into your coding assistant's system prompt to get Linus-style reviews in any language. Public domain (CC0).
